title: VulCPE: Context-Aware Cybersecurity Vulnerability Retrieval and Management
abstract: arXiv:2505.13895v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The dynamic landscape of cybersecurity demands precise and scalable solutions for vulnerability management in heterogeneous systems, where configuration-specific vulnerabilities are often misidentified due to inconsistent data in databases like the National Vulnerability Database (NVD). Inaccurate Common Platform Enumeration (CPE) data in NVD further leads to false positives and incomplete vulnerability retrieval. Informed by our systematic analysis of CPE and CVEdeails data, revealing more than 50% vendor name inconsistencies, we propose VulCPE, a framework that standardizes data and models configuration dependencies using a unified CPE schema (uCPE), entity recognition, relation extraction, and graph-based modeling. VulCPE achieves superior retrieval precision (0.766) and coverage (0.926) over existing tools. VulCPE ensures precise, context-aware vulnerability management, enhancing cyber resilience.

translated_title: VulCPE：情境感知的网络安全漏洞检索与管理
translated_abstract: 网络安全动态变化的环境要求对异构系统中的漏洞管理提供精确且可扩展的解决方案，而在这些系统中，由于诸如国家漏洞数据库（NVD）等数据库中的数据不一致，特定配置相关的漏洞经常被错误识别。NVD中不准确的通用平台枚举（CPE）数据进一步导致了误报和漏洞检索不完整的问题。基于我们对CPE和CVE Details数据的系统分析，发现超过50%的厂商名称存在不一致性，我们提出了VulCPE框架，该框架利用统一CPE模式、实体识别、关系抽取和基于图的建模来标准化数据并建模配置依赖关系。VulCPE相比现有工具实现了更优的检索精确度（0.766）和覆盖率（0.926）。VulCPE确保了精确的、情境感知的漏洞管理，增强了网络韧性。
tldr: VulCPE通过统一CPE数据标准化、实体识别、关系抽取和图建模来刻画配置依赖关系，解决了NVD中CPE数据不准确导致的漏洞误报和检索不完整问题，实现了比现有工具更高的检索精确度（0.766）和覆盖率（0.926）。
en_tdlr: VulCPE standardizes CPE data and models configuration dependencies through a unified CPE schema, entity recognition, relation extraction, and graph-based modeling, addressing false positives and incomplete retrieval caused by inaccurate NVD data, and achieving superior retrieval precision (0.766) and coverage (0.926) over existing tools.
